issues.description: Plan line 26 specifies that a first run occurs when `getItem` returns `null` or an empty string (`""`), and in this case immediately overwrites storage with an empty list ('처음 실행은 getItem 결과가 null 또는 빈 문자열일 때이다. 이 경우 바로 빈 목록으로 덮어쓴다.'). An empty string is an existing malformed value rather than an absent key (`null`). Overwriting on `""` contradicts the subsequent rule in line 26 that malformed JSON must cause an error and prevent arbitrary overwriting or correction ('잘못된 JSON... 은 오류이며... 원본 저장값을 임의 보정하거나 덮어쓰지 않는다'). Under the data-preservation rule, 'otherwise preserve data' cannot cure this destructive exception.
issues.suggestedDirection: Distinguish absent (`null`), empty (`""`), and malformed stored values. Only treat `null` (key absent) as uninitialized, and treat an empty string `""` as malformed data that preserves the existing value and blocks writes without overwriting.

decision.feedback: issue-6df15d9998a2d155: Plan line 26 specifies that a first run occurs when `getItem` returns `null` or an empty string (`""`), and in this case immediately overwrites storage with an empty list ('처음 실행은 getItem 결과가 null 또는 빈 문자열일 때이다. 이 경우 바로 빈 목록으로 덮어쓴다.'). An empty string is an existing malformed value rather than an absent key (`null`). Overwriting on `""` contradicts the subsequent rule in line 26 that malformed JSON must cause an error and prevent arbitrary overwriting or correction ('잘못된 JSON... 은 오류이며... 원본 저장값을 임의 보정하거나 덮어쓰지 않는다'). Under the data-preservation rule, 'otherwise preserve data' cannot cure this destructive exception. — Distinguish absent (`null`), empty (`""`), and malformed stored values. Only treat `null` (key absent) as uninitialized, and treat an empty string `""` as malformed data that preserves the existing value and blocks writes without overwriting.
